# principal to the parts held), then this country's slots as a holder.

	zz_ef_bl_roll = { F = redeem }

	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_ratio value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_woff_now } remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_woff_now }
	if = {

			has_variable = zz_ef_bl_held
			var:zz_ef_bl_held > 0
			zz_ef_bl_principal < var:zz_ef_bl_held

		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_ratio value = zz_ef_bl_principal }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_ratio divide = var:zz_ef_bl_held }
		# default: the principal more than halved in a week IN DEFAULT -> the parts over it are written off. Run
		# r1005_163333 (5.10 evening): Russia repaid its last 450K in one week and the holders' parts were written off --
		# a repayment is bought back from the pool, only the engine's default (in_default) writes off.
		if = {

# var:zz_ef_f_bl_$F$ = var:zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ (summed by the holders since our last step); the sum restarts.
zz_ef_bl_roll = {
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_$F$ value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_$F$ value = var:zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ }
	}
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ value = 0 }
}

# Holder scope, slot $N$ just bought: var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ = E&F's price, var:zz_ef_bs_$N$ = the seller. The part is at
# most the seller's room (principal - the parts held); the rest back to our treasury; the part's price into the
# seller's pool.
zz_ef_bl_register = {
	var:zz_ef_bs_$N$ = { save_scope_as = zz_ef_bl_seller }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = scope:zz_ef_bl_seller.zz_ef_bl_room }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ > var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y value = var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y subtract = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		add_treasury = var:zz_ef_bl_y
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_refund add = var:zz_ef_bl_y }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bh_$N$ value = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	}
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_buy add = var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
	scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_held } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held add = root.var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
		zz_ef_bl_acc_add = { F = sold V = root.var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
		add_investment_pool = root.var:zz_ef_bh_$N$
	}
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_x
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_y } remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_y }
}

# Holder scope, slot $N$ live: the seller's principal under the parts -> our part cut (paid back from its pool, or
# written off in a default); then the week's interest on what is left, from its pool.
zz_ef_bl_hold = {
	var:zz_ef_bs_$N$ = { save_scope_as = zz_ef_bl_seller }
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = {
				has_variable = zz_ef_bl_ratio
				var:zz_ef_bl_ratio < 1
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x multiply = { value = 1 subtract = scope:zz_ef_bl_seller.var:zz_ef_bl_ratio } }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bh_$N$ subtract = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held subtract = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x } }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_woff_now } }
			change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_lost add = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
			scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { zz_ef_bl_acc_add = { F = woff V = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x } }
		}
		else = {
			zz_ef_bl_pay = { F = redeem TO = zz_ef_f_bl_back SHORT = zz_ef_f_bl_lost INTO = add_treasury }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x multiply = scope:zz_ef_bl_seller.zz_ef_bl_int_per_part }
	zz_ef_bl_pay = { F = int_out TO = zz_ef_f_bl_int_in SHORT = zz_ef_f_bl_int_short INTO = add_treasury }
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_x
}

# Holder scope, slot $N$ ended (E&F's maturity, its payout removed): the seller's pool buys the part back.
zz_ef_bl_end = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zz_ef_bs_$N$
			exists = var:zz_ef_bs_$N$
			var:zz_ef_bs_$N$ = { is_country_type = recognized }
		}
		var:zz_ef_bs_$N$ = { save_scope_as = zz_ef_bl_seller }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
		scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held subtract = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x } }
		zz_ef_bl_pay = { F = redeem TO = zz_ef_f_bl_back SHORT = zz_ef_f_bl_lost INTO = add_treasury }
		remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_x
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_lost add = var:zz_ef_bh_$N$ }
	}
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bh_$N$
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bs_$N$ } remove_variable = zz_ef_bs_$N$ }
}

# Holder scope: var:zz_ef_bl_x from scope:zz_ef_bl_seller's pool (at most what it holds) to our treasury ($INTO$ =
# add_treasury) or our pool (add_investment_pool, private banks);
# the seller sums it under $F$, we under var:$TO$; what its pool could not pay -- under var:$SHORT$.
zz_ef_bl_pay = {
	change_variable = { name = $SHORT$ add = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	set_variable = {
		name = zz_ef_bl_x
		value = {
			value = var:zz_ef_bl_x
			max = {
				value = scope:zz_ef_bl_seller.investment_pool
				min = 0
			}
			min = 0
		}
	}
	scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = {
		add_investment_pool = {
			value = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x
			multiply = -1
		}
		zz_ef_bl_acc_add = { F = $F$ V = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	}
	$INTO$ = var:zz_ef_bl_x
	change_variable = { name = $TO$ add = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	change_variable = { name = $SHORT$ subtract = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
}

# Seller scope: var:zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ += $V$.
zz_ef_bl_acc_add = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_acc_$F$ add = $V$ }
}

# slot 1: E&F's ai_buy_bond_1_on / ai_seller_country_general_1 / ai_total_bond_value_1
zz_ef_bl_slot_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ai_buy_bond_1_on
			var:ai_buy_bond_1_on = 1
			NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_bh_1 }
			has_variable = ai_seller_country_general_1
			has_variable = ai_total_bond_value_1
			exists = var:ai_seller_country_general_1
			var:ai_seller_country_general_1 = { is_country_type = recognized }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bs_1 value = var:ai_seller_country_general_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bh_1 value = var:ai_total_bond_value_1 }
		zz_ef_bl_register = { N = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zz_ef_bh_1
			has_variable = ai_buy_bond_1_on
			var:ai_buy_bond_1_on = 1
			has_variable = zz_ef_bs_1
			exists = var:zz_ef_bs_1
		}
		zz_ef_bl_hold = { N = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bh_1 }
		zz_ef_bl_end = { N = 1 }
	}
}

			var:ai_buy_bond_8_on = 1
			has_variable = zz_ef_bs_8
			exists = var:zz_ef_bs_8
		}
		zz_ef_bl_hold = { N = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bh_8 }
		zz_ef_bl_end = { N = 8 }
	}
}

# slot 9: E&F's ai_buy_bond_9_on / ai_seller_country_general_9 / ai_total_bond_value_9
zz_ef_bl_slot_9 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ai_buy_bond_9_on
			var:ai_buy_bond_9_on = 1
			NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_bh_9 }
			has_variable = ai_seller_country_general_9
			has_variable = ai_total_bond_value_9
			exists = var:ai_seller_country_general_9
			var:ai_seller_country_general_9 = { is_country_type = recognized }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bs_9 value = var:ai_seller_country_general_9 }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bh_9 value = var:ai_total_bond_value_9 }
		zz_ef_bl_register = { N = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zz_ef_bh_9
			has_variable = ai_buy_bond_9_on
			var:ai_buy_bond_9_on = 1
			has_variable = zz_ef_bs_9
			exists = var:zz_ef_bs_9
		}
		zz_ef_bl_hold = { N = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bh_9 }
		zz_ef_bl_end = { N = 9 }
	}
}

# Buyer scope, private banks' slot $N$ rose (E&F's purchase or reinforcement): var:zz_ef_pb_v - var:zz_ef_pbh_$N$ bought
# from scope:zz_ef_bl_seller; the part at most its room, the rest back to our pool and off E&F's value.
zz_ef_pb_buy = {
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = var:zz_ef_pb_v }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x subtract = var:zz_ef_pbh_$N$ }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y value = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y subtract = scope:zz_ef_bl_seller.zz_ef_bl_room }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zz_ef_bl_y > 0 }
		add_investment_pool = var:zz_ef_bl_y
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_pb_refund add = var:zz_ef_bl_y }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x subtract = var:zz_ef_bl_y }
		zz_ef_pb_cut = { N = $N$ }
	}
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_pb_buy add = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_held } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held add = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		zz_ef_bl_acc_add = { F = sold V = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		add_investment_pool = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x
	}
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_x
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_y
}

# Buyer scope, slot $N$ rose with no seller found in E&F's list (run s1g: Britain 1838.1, 1.95M): no debt to hold a
# part of -- the whole purchase back to our pool and off E&F's value (only existing debt is bought).
zz_ef_pb_no_seller = {
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y value = var:zz_ef_pb_v }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y subtract = var:zz_ef_pbh_$N$ }
	add_investment_pool = var:zz_ef_bl_y
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_pb_refund add = var:zz_ef_bl_y }
	debug_log = "EFP|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|slot $N$|no_seller [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('zz_ef_bl_y').GetValue|0]"
	zz_ef_pb_cut = { N = $N$ }
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_y
}

# Buyer scope: E&F's value of slot $N$ down by var:zz_ef_bl_y (at most to 0), its interest scaled with it.
zz_ef_pb_cut = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_$N$ > 0 }
		set_variable = {
			name = zz_ef_pb_r
			value = {
				value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_$N$
				subtract = var:zz_ef_bl_y
				divide = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_$N$
				min = 0
				max = 1
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_$N$ multiply = var:zz_ef_pb_r }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_$N$ }
			change_variable = { name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_$N$ multiply = var:zz_ef_pb_r }
		}
		remove_variable = zz_ef_pb_r
	}
}

# Buyer scope, slot $N$ fell below what we registered (E&F reset it -- its seller gone): written off, nobody pays.
zz_ef_pb_drop = {
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = var:zz_ef_pbh_$N$ }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x subtract = var:zz_ef_pb_v }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_lost add = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zz_ef_pbs_$N$
			exists = var:zz_ef_pbs_$N$
			var:zz_ef_pbs_$N$ = { is_country_type = recognized }
		}
		var:zz_ef_pbs_$N$ = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_held } change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held subtract = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x } }
			zz_ef_bl_acc_add = { F = woff V = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_pbh_$N$ value = var:zz_ef_pb_v }
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_x
}

# Buyer scope, slot $N$ live, the seller's principal under the parts held: our part cut by (1 - ratio) -- bought back
# from its pool into ours, or written off in a default.
zz_ef_pb_cutback = {
	var:zz_ef_pbs_$N$ = { save_scope_as = zz_ef_bl_seller }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x value = var:zz_ef_pbh_$N$ }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_x multiply = { value = 1 subtract = scope:zz_ef_bl_seller.var:zz_ef_bl_ratio } }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_y value = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	zz_ef_pb_cut = { N = $N$ }
	change_variable = { name = zz_ef_pbh_$N$ subtract = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
	scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { change_variable = { name = zz_ef_bl_held subtract = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x } }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { has_variable = zz_ef_bl_woff_now } }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_bl_lost add = var:zz_ef_bl_x }
		scope:zz_ef_bl_seller = { zz_ef_bl_acc_add = { F = woff V = root.var:zz_ef_bl_x } }
	}
	else = {
		zz_ef_bl_pay = { F = redeem TO = zz_ef_f_pb_back SHORT = zz_ef_f_bl_lost INTO = add_investment_pool }
	}
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_x
	remove_variable = zz_ef_bl_y
}

# private banks' slot 1: E&F's ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1 / ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_1
zz_ef_pb_slot_1 = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_pbh_1 } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_pbh_1 value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_pb_v value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1 } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_pb_v value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zz_ef_pb_v > var:zz_ef_pbh_1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_1 }
			random_in_list = {
				variable = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_1
				limit = { is_country_type = recognized }
				save_scope_as = zz_ef_pbsel_1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:zz_ef_pbsel_1 }
			scope:zz_ef_pbsel_1 = { save_scope_as = zz_ef_bl_seller }
			set_variable = { name = zz_ef_pbs_1 value = scope:zz_ef_pbsel_1 }
			zz_ef_pb_buy = { N = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			zz_ef_pb_no_seller = { N = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_pbh_1 value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zz_ef_pb_v < var:zz_ef_pbh_1 }
		zz_ef_pb_drop = { N = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zz_ef_pbh_1 > 0
			has_variable = zz_ef_pbs_1
			exists = var:zz_ef_pbs_1
			var:zz_ef_pbs_1 = {
				is_country_type = recognized
				has_variable = zz_ef_bl_ratio
				var:zz_ef_bl_ratio < 1
			}
		}
		zz_ef_pb_cutback = { N = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zz_ef_pbh_1 <= 0 has_variable = zz_ef_pbs_1 }
		remove_variable = zz_ef_pbs_1
	}
}
